title: The end stool
logline: Gully's counter. The end stool empty. Gully's hand on the counter beside it, the rest of him out of frame. No Wood in the pages from January to June.

panels.composition: The counter at Gully's from stool height. The end stool, empty, its seat worn to a paler ring. A coffee already poured in front of it. At the frame's left edge: a hand on the counter, thick, a canvas cuff — Gully — and nothing else of him. The corkboard above, crowded, the 2003 rough still at its center.

characters.pose: a hand and a cuff at the frame edge

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bait-and-espresso counter seen from stool height with the end stool empty and worn pale, a poured coffee in front of it, a stocky man's hand and canvas jacket cuff resting on the counter at the frame's edge, a crowded corkboard above, no words
